description: Tells the translation tables about the words the plugin shows.

description: A panel that counts the objects in the open scene.

description: A Tool that reports the cell you click.

description: Turns a data table into a CSV file.

description: A target that asks for a start scene.

description: Draws the Score component as a number box.

description: A beacon you can place.

description: A "Small arena" starter.

description: Warns about objects called "TODO".

description: A button that makes the bot wait ten seconds.

description: Lets the solver try waiting a moment before a plate.
